nodes.label: pijin_core JS library
nodes.rationale: JavaScript library for calling the Soroban contract pijin_core through Soroban RPC. Generated by the Soroban CLI. It can be published with npm publish or depended on by file path. The suggested approach is a postinstall script that regenerates the bindings into node_modules, because NPM has removed local library directories it treats as erroneous during install. It exports Contract, a networks constant, and an async function per contract method, with documentation taken from the contract author's comments.

nodes.label: pijin_core contract binding
nodes.rationale: Generated for contract id CCLCYVBYAKKPDXZ3BSQHWO5FQE7IZIV4RYABDFVJQQIXV27FNOLTGOAW, RPC https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org, and network passphrase Test SDF Network ; September 2015. The passphrase and contract id are exported from index.ts on the networks constant. The sample spreads networks.futurenet and says to check which networks the generated library actually exports, so futurenet may only be an example.

nodes.label: Soroban
nodes.rationale: Stellar smart contract platform. This library talks to a Soroban contract through Soroban RPC. The readme cites https://soroban.stellar.org/ and the public RPC provider list.

nodes.label: soroban-example-dapp local library note

nodes.rationale: Cited discussion of trouble consuming a Soroban binding as a local NPM path: https://github.com/stellar/soroban-example-dapp/pull/117#discussion_r1232873560. The suggested workaround is generating the library in postinstall instead.
